title: CPVPbot
description: CPVPbot is a plugin that lets players spawn and manage a PvP training bot.
body:
CPVPbot is a plugin that lets players spawn and manage a PvP training bot with flexible config, GUI editing, and localization.
### Main Features
- PvP bot spawn and control via `/bot`
- Bot presets and real-time settings menu
- Armor + shield behavior tuning
- Stacked totems in bot hands
- Auto language by player client locale
- Full GUI customization (item type, name, lore, layout elements)
- Configurable GUI background (material or disable)
- Skin modes:
  - `mirror_skin` (copy spawner skin)
  - `skin_list` (random from configured names)
- World spawn restrictions:
  - whitelist
  - blacklist
  - `use-blacklist` / `use-whitelist`
- RTP spawn flow:
  - source worlds (`from-worlds`)
  - destination worlds (`to-worlds`)
  - configurable RTP radius
- Reload command for configs/localization

### Commands
- `/bot` - open bot menu / manage your bot
- `/bot reload` - reload plugin configuration files

### Permissions
- `bot.use` - use main bot command
- `bot.reload` - reload config
- (optional legacy) `bot.totem`, `bot.shield`

### Configurable Files
- `config.yml` - core options (world rules, skins, RTP, GUI background)
- `gui-items.yml` - every GUI item (material, name, lore keys, etc.)
- `lang/*.yml` - full localization (messages, GUI names/lore, states)

### Color Formatting
Supports MiniMessage color tags in language and GUI text:
- `<gray>Text`
- `<#25d366>Text`
- Any valid MiniMessage formatting tags
